q40nrjva.baseName: Walplus 150 LED String Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
q40nrjva.variantName: Walplus 150 LED String Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
q40nrjva.sourceDescription: This modern artificial Christmas tree exudes a sleek, contemporary style perfect for those who appreciate minimalistic elegance. Defined by its clean lines and functional design, this piece seamlessly blends into both indoor and outdoor settings, offering a sophisticated touch to your festive decor. Its attractive cone shape and warm LED lighting transform any space into a winter wonderland, creating a cozy atmosphere for families and guests. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this modern artificial Christmas tree provides a sense of real evergreen foliage without the maintenance of a live tree. The use of PVC ensures durability and a lifelike appearance that stays vibrant season after season. Its green hue complements any holiday decor with elegance. Included Components: Equipped with LED strip lights and a USB plug, this tree offers convenient, safe lighting. The LEDs emit a warm white glow, filling your space with an inviting ambiance. Easily adjustable, these lights let you craft the perfect atmosphere at your holiday gatherings. Decorative Features: This tree features simple yet striking decorations that enhance its sleek modern look. The decorative accents lend an air of elegance and sophistication, turning your living area or outdoor space into a holiday sanctuary. Recommended Uses: Ideal for various settings, from cozy living rooms to open terraces. Its compact yet prominent presence adapts beautifully to small spaces or as a centerpiece in larger rooms, offering flexibility in decorating styles. Care &Maintenance: For best results, cover the tree when not in use to protect from dust and debris. A certified 5V USB power source is required to operate the tree's LED lights, ensuring optimal performance throughout the holiday season. Product Specifications Colour: White PVC and plastic and steel and PE Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 63 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Hinged Branches for Easy Setup Lifelike Tips Snow Flocked Number of PE tips: 130 Number of PVC tips: 345 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 150 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Foldable stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

amjey06x.sourceDescription: This elegant Artificial Christmas Tree blends modern style with traditional charm, featuring a sleek cone shape that enhances its visual appeal. Designed to be adorned with warm white decorative LED lights, it brings festive charm to any room or terrace, creating a cozy ambiance for the Christmas season. With a theme dedicated to Christmas, this tree is suitable for various holiday settings, providing a delightful focal point for indoor or outdoor decor. Its clean lines and minimal ornamentation complement contemporary living spaces while offering a functional holiday solution for families, event hosts, and festive enthusiasts. PVC and PE Materials: This tree is crafted from premium PE and PVC materials, ensuring both durability and an authentic look. These materials are known for being flame retardant, adding a layer of safety to your holiday setup. The tree maintains a vibrant green appearance without fading, providing an evergreen display that lasts all season. The combination of these materials brings realism to your festive decorations, offering a reliable and attractive solution for annual celebrations. Decorative LED String Lights: Equipped with warm white LED string lights, this tree illuminates your space with a gentle glow. The lights come with 8 flash modes, allowing you to adjust the lighting to fit your mood—whether you’re hosting a festive gathering or enjoying a silent night in. This lighting feature also enhances the tree’s ornamental value, making it a standout piece in your holiday décor. USB Power Source: This tree includes a USB power source, offering flexibility in where it can be displayed indoors or outdoors. The USB feature eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making setup convenient and practical. It is an ideal choice for modern homes where power access is limited, ensuring the tree can be placed almost anywhere. Versatile Room Placement: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this tree offers a versatile solution for holiday decorating. Whether it's in a living room corner, a garden patio, or a terrace, its adaptable size complements various environments and styles. The tree acts as a festive connector among friends and families during yearly seasonal celebrations. Care and Setup Instructions: Assembly requires two individuals for easy setup following the manufacturer’s instructions. Ensure proper placement and stability of the synthetic plastic stand for an upright and secure display throughout the holiday season. Its simple assembly process allows you to focus more on enjoying the festive period. sntxnan6.baseName: Garden Pride Plastic the Volcano 10 Christmas Tree Stand - Green
sntxnan6.variantName: Garden Pride Plastic the Volcano 10 Christmas Tree Stand - Green
sntxnan6.sourceDescription: Nothing says Christmas quite like a real, live tree. However, you need to be safe. It's important to make sure the focal point of your festive decorations is properly secured. This plastic Christmas tree stand is designed to safely hold real trees up to seven feet tall with bases of up to five inches steady thanks to three sturdy thumbscrews. The screws are twisted into the base of the tree, anchoring it into the stand and holding it steady, no matter how much tinsel, fairy lights, and baubles are used to dress it! A six-litre water capacity and convenient built-in spill guard make keeping your Christmas tree healthy easy, and additional screw holes give the option of fixing the stand to the floor for extra support. This product is intended for domestic use only. Ensure it is securely installed or positioned before use. Inspect regularly for signs of damage or wear. Keep out of reach of young children. This product is not a toy. Use only as intended. Chartwell House, 40 Chartwell Road, Lancing, BN15 8TY
